verdicts.rationale: POST /cluster/recover returning 500 'Qdrant is running in standalone mode' is NOT a bug. 源码lib/storage/src/content_manager/toc/mod.rs:775-778显式检查consensus_proposal_sender.as_ref()，为None时返回standalone mode错误。Raft recover是cluster-only功能，在standalone mode下不可用是intentional design。Contract描述'Recover current peer Raft state'暗示cluster requirement。GET /cluster返回status='disabled'确认standalone状态。源码注释和错误消息明确表明这是mode enforcement而非bug。
